title: Translation invariance of a polynomial sign class
statement: For any natural numbers $n$ and $d$, the class of real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional cube over $ bf_2$ obtained by encoding $ bf_2$-valued functions of algebraic degree at most $d$ as signs is closed under translations: if $F$ belongs to this class and $z$ is any cube point, then $x\mapsto F(x+z)$ also belongs to it.
